identification: Cream painted composition/cork (moulded fibre) fire helmet with comb, red and silver enamel FBC badge on front (Fire Brigades Commission, Tasmania), green-painted underside, leather liner and chinstrap. Mid 20th century. Armitage estimate 50-100.

entries.note: Vintage fireman's helmet, brown canvas and compressed cork, London pattern c1938-41. Same construction type but not Tasmanian, no badge. Database record only, page not opened. Hammer, no premium.

NSW Fire Brigade 19th century brass helmet. Different material and age, category guide only. Database record only.
Melbourne MFB brass helmet c1950, fair. Old sale (over 10 years), brass. Database record only.
Fire Brigades Commission of Tasmania long service medal. Shows collector demand for FBC Tasmania items only, not a helmet. Database record only.
